---
title: Metadata standard
---

The metadata every submission has to follow: the [MetaFleX](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/bigpicture-metaflex) XML schemas, and the mandatory attributes in [MSMDAD](../datasets/submission/key-concepts.qmd#msmdad).

## Used for

- [Data exploration services](data-exploration.qmd)
- [Data access services](data-access.qmd)
- [Data contributing services](data-contributing.qmd)
